024
025public class SkillsChangeRemoveSmodsEffect extends BaseSkillsChangeEffect {
026
027        public static class SmodRemovalEffectData {
028                FleetMemberAPI member;
029                List<SModRecord> records = new ArrayList<SModRecord>();
030                int maxBefore;
031                int maxAfter;
032                int numSmods;
033                int remove;
034                boolean offerChoice = false;
035                List<String> removeList = new ArrayList<String>();
036                
037                List<ButtonAPI> buttons = new ArrayList<ButtonAPI>();
038        }
039        
040        public static class SmodDataMap {
041                Map<FleetMemberAPI, SmodRemovalEffectData> map = new LinkedHashMap<FleetMemberAPI, SmodRemovalEffectData>();
042        }
043        public void setMap(SmodDataMap map, Map<String, Object> dataMap) {
044                String key = getClass().getSimpleName();
045                dataMap.put(key, map);
046        }
047        public SmodDataMap getMap(Map<String, Object> dataMap) {
048                String key = getClass().getSimpleName();
049                SmodDataMap map = (SmodDataMap)dataMap.get(key);
050                if (map == null) {
051                        map = new SmodDataMap();
052                        dataMap.put(key, map);
053                }
054                return map;
055        }
056        
057        public SmodDataMap getEffects(MutableCharacterStatsAPI from, MutableCharacterStatsAPI to) {
058                SmodDataMap result = new SmodDataMap();
059                
060                
061                for (SModRecord record : PlaythroughLog.getInstance().getSModsInstalled()) {
062                        FleetMemberAPI member = record.getMember();
063                        if (member == null) continue;
064                        if (record.getSMods().isEmpty()) continue;
065                        String modId = record.getSMods().get(0);
066                        if (!member.getVariant().getSMods().contains(modId)) continue;
067                        if (!member.getVariant().getHullMods().contains(modId)) continue;
068                        
069                        SmodRemovalEffectData data = result.map.get(member);
070                        if (data == null) {
071                                data = new SmodRemovalEffectData();
072                                data.member = member;
073                                data.numSmods = member.getVariant().getSMods().size();
074                                data.maxBefore = Misc.getMaxPermanentMods(member, from);
075                                data.maxAfter = Misc.getMaxPermanentMods(member, to);
076                                result.map.put(member, data);
077                        }
078                        data.records.add(record);
079                }
080                
081                for (FleetMemberAPI member : new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>(result.map.keySet())) {
082                        SmodRemovalEffectData data = result.map.get(member);
083                        if (data.maxBefore <= data.maxAfter || data.records.isEmpty() ||
084                                        data.numSmods <= data.maxAfter) {
085                                result.map.remove(member);
086                        } else {
087                                data.remove = Math.min(data.numSmods - data.maxAfter, data.records.size());
088                                data.offerChoice = data.remove <= 1 && 
089                                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getMembersListCopy().contains(data.member);
090                                if (!data.offerChoice) {
091                                        List<SModRecord> copy = new ArrayList<SModRecord>(data.records);
092                                        for (int i = 0; i < data.remove; i++) {
093                                                int minCost = 10000;
094                                                SModRecord minCostMod = null;
095                                                for (SModRecord record : data.records) {
096                                                        HullModSpecAPI mod = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(record.getSMods().get(0));
097                                                        int cost = mod.getCostFor(member.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
098                                                        if (cost < minCost) {
099                                                                minCostMod = record;
100                                                                minCost = cost;
101                                                        }
102                                                }
103                                                if (minCostMod != null) {
104                                                        data.removeList.add(minCostMod.getSMods().get(0));
105                                                        copy.remove(minCostMod);
106                                                }
107                                        }
108                                }
109                        }
110                }
111                
112                return result;
113        }
114        
115        
116        @Override
117        public boolean hasEffects(MutableCharacterStatsAPI from, MutableCharacterStatsAPI to) {
118                return !getEffects(from, to).map.isEmpty();
119        }
120
121        @Override
122        public void printEffects(MutableCharacterStatsAPI from, MutableCharacterStatsAPI to, TooltipMakerAPI info, Map<String, Object> dataMap) {
123                super.prepare();
124                
125                SmodDataMap map = getEffects(from, to);
126                setMap(map, dataMap);
127                
128                float pad = 3f;
129                float opad = 10f;
130                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
131                
132                float initPad = 15f;
133                info.addSectionHeading("S-mods", base, dark, Alignment.MID, initPad);
134                initPad = opad;
135//              for (SmodRemovalEffectData data : map.map.values()) {
136//                      if (!data.offerChoice) {
137                                info.addPara("Ships that you've built s-mods into that now have more than their maximum"
138                                                + " number of s-mods will have the cheapest s-mods removed.", initPad, 
139                                                Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(),
140                                                "cheapest s-mods removed");
141                                initPad = 15f;
142                                info.addPara("If only one s-mod is being removed, and the ship is currently in your fleet, "
143                                                + "you can select which s-mod to remove. S-mods you did not build into a ship will not be removed, even if the ship is over the limit.", opad);
144//                              break;
145//                      }
146//              }
147                
148                for (SmodRemovalEffectData data : map.map.values()) {
149                        final FleetMemberAPI member = data.member;
150                        
151                        if (data.offerChoice) {
152                                String str = "The " + member.getShipName() +
153                                " (" + member.getHullSpec().getHullNameWithDashClass() + "), will lose its built-in...";
154                                info.addPara(str, initPad);
155                                
156                                float bw = 470;
157                                float bh = 25;
158                                float indent = 40f;
159                                UIComponentAPI prev = null;
160                                int minCost = 10000;
161                                ButtonAPI minCostButton = null;
162                                Set<String> seen = new LinkedHashSet<>();
163                                for (SModRecord record : data.records) {
164                                        HullModSpecAPI mod = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(record.getSMods().get(0));
165                                        if (mod == null) continue;
166                                        if (seen.contains(mod.getId())) continue;
167                                        seen.add(mod.getId());
168                                        float p = opad;
169                                        if (prev != null) p = pad;
170                                        int cost = mod.getCostFor(member.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
171                                        ButtonAPI b = info.addAreaCheckbox(
172                                                        mod.getDisplayName() + " (" + cost + " OP)", new Object(), base, dark, bright, bw, bh, p, true);
173                                        data.buttons.add(b);
174
175                                        if (prev == null) {
176                                                b.getPosition().setXAlignOffset(indent);
177                                        }
178                                        prev = b;
179                                        if (cost < minCost) {
180                                                minCostButton = b;
181                                                minCost = cost;
182                                        }
183                                }
184                                if (minCostButton != null) {
185                                        minCostButton.setChecked(true);
186                                }
187                                
188                                info.addSpacer(0).getPosition().setXAlignOffset(-indent);
189                        }
190                }
191        }
192        
193        @Override
194        public void infoButtonPressed(ButtonAPI button, Object param, Map<String, Object> dataMap) {
195                SmodDataMap map = getMap(dataMap);
196                
197                for (SmodRemovalEffectData data : map.map.values()) {
198                        boolean found = false;
199                        for (ButtonAPI b : data.buttons) {
200                                if (b == button) {
201                                        found = true;
202                                        break;
203                                }
204                        }
205                        if (found) {
206                                for (ButtonAPI b : data.buttons) {
207                                        if (b == button) {
208                                                b.setChecked(true);
209                                        } else {
210                                                b.setChecked(false);
211                                        }
212                                }
213                                break;
214                        }
215                }
216        }
217        
218        @Override
219        public void applyEffects(MutableCharacterStatsAPI from, MutableCharacterStatsAPI to, Map<String, Object> dataMap) {
220                SmodDataMap map = getMap(dataMap);
221                
222                for (SmodRemovalEffectData data : map.map.values()) {
223                        ShipVariantAPI variant = data.member.getVariant();
224                        variant = variant.clone();
225                        variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
226                        
227                        if (data.offerChoice) {
228                                int index = 0;
229                                for (ButtonAPI b : data.buttons) {
230                                        if (b.isChecked()) {
231                                                SModRecord record = data.records.get(index);
232                                                data.removeList.add(record.getSMods().get(0));
233                                        }
234                                        index++;
235                                }
236                        }
237                        for (String modId : data.removeList) {
238                                variant.removePermaMod(modId);
239                        }
240                        data.member.setVariant(variant, false, false);
241                }
242        }
243        
244}
